prompt: Can you review the test quality of evals/files/weak_tests.py? It's the test suite for the URL parser in evals/files/url_parser.py. I want to know if the tests are any good and what should be improved.

assertions.text: Identifies the unconditional @pytest.mark.skip as a problem
Identifies 'print instead of assert' in test_unicode_url as a bug
Identifies 'assert result is not None' as a weak assertion pattern
Identifies the mock-everything integration test as a unit test in disguise
Measures or discusses assertion density and flags it as low
Prioritizes fixes by severity (security/critical issues first)
Provides an improved version of the tests (not just critique)
Improved tests have higher assertion density than the original
